summary: Enhance your skills with our Risk Assessment and Adaptation Planning for Climate Change training. Prepare for future challenges and drive effective solutions.
lede: Climate risk assessment and adaptation planning help project managers, environment officers, resilience practitioners, and resource managers identify hazards and plan practical responses. Participants practice mapping exposure and vulnerability, ranking risks, selecting feasible adaptation measures, and integrating actions into plans, budgets, monitoring, and stakeholder briefings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who routinely manage climate-exposed plans, budgets, assets, or communities. It targets those in climate-sensitive sectors who need to anticipate and adapt to climate risks effectively.
audience: Program and project managers in climate-sensitive sectors
Climate change and environment officers (public, NGO
Disaster risk reduction (DRR) and resilience practitioners
Urban planners and infrastructure/public works teams
Agriculture, water, and natural resource management professionals
Supply chain, operations, and facilities managers
Corporate sustainability/ESG leads and risk managers
modules: Foundations of Climate Risk and Resilience Thinking
Understanding Climate Hazards and Local Risk Context
Vulnerability Assessment and Root Cause Analysis
Designing Adaptation Options That Work in Reality
Adaptation Planning and Integration into Project Cycles
Budgeting and Resource Mobilization for Adaptation
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for Adaptation
Climate Risk Communication and Stakeholder Alignment
Capstone Simulation: Build a Climate Risk Assessment and Adaptation Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management and an interest in climate risk and adaptation. Familiarity with environmental or resource management is helpful but not required.
